# T7 Sherlock model check (candidate reconstruction)

G1 failed: the download has no grid model. This script tests the candidate `pandapower.networks.create_cigre_network_mv(with_der="all")` against the recorded ground truth (`raw/train/physical.zip`). Inputs set from each snapshot: external grid voltage and angle, all load, sgen and storage P and Q, connection states, and all 32 recorded switch states. Switches 0 to 7 are pandapower's own switches, in the same order. Switches 8 to 31 are mapped as: switch 8+2l is the from end of line l, 9+2l the to end (lines 0 to 11). This mapping was inferred from the data: switches 18 and 19 open together when line 5 is out for cable maintenance; switch 25 is the separator moved in the train playbook; the IPAL state groups switch 8 with line 0 at bus 1 and switch 28 with line 10 at bus 12. It is checked below on every open switch. Storage sign follows pandapower (positive = charging); this is an assumption.

The voltage error should be read against the noise floor: Sherlock's recorded values carry noise of the size given above, on inputs as well as outputs. These numbers say whether the oracle's model matches the dataset's own physics in the tap-0 states. Tap positions other than 0 need the tap changer parameters (step size, side, range), which are not in the download.
